Package com.stockroom.service

Class InputValidator

java.lang.Object
com.stockroom.service.InputValidator
public final class InputValidator extends Object
Parses and validates the raw text the user types for an item.

All input rules live here, not in the GUI. Each method takes the raw string from a text field and either returns a clean value or throws an InvalidItemException whose message can be shown to the user as it is.

Numbers are parsed with BigInteger, so very large input such as "99999999999" is reported as too large instead of overflowing an int.

      public static int parseThreshold(String raw) throws InvalidItemException
      Parses and validates a low-stock threshold. Blank input means the default threshold.
      Parameters:
      raw - the threshold exactly as typed; may be null or blank
      Returns:
      the threshold, between 0 and 10000, or Item.DEFAULT_THRESHOLD when the input is blank

    • parseId

      public static int parseId(String raw) throws InvalidItemException
      Parses an item ID typed in to look an item up. A leading # is allowed, so both "7" and "#0007" mean ID 7. Whether an item with this ID exists is checked by the inventory manager, not here.
      Parameters:
      raw - the ID exactly as typed; may be null
      Returns:
      the ID, between 1 and Integer.MAX_VALUE
      Throws:
      InvalidItemException - if the text is blank, not a whole number, zero, negative, or too large to be an ID

    • parseWholeNumber

      private static int parseWholeNumber(String text, InvalidItemException.Field field, String label, int max, String maxLabel, String example) throws InvalidItemException
      Parses non-blank, trimmed text as a whole number from 0 up to a maximum.
      Parameters:
      text - the trimmed, non-blank text to parse
      field - the field reported in any exception thrown
      label - the field name used at the start of each message
      max - the largest value allowed
      maxLabel - the maximum written for the user, such as "1,000,000"
      example - an example value shown in the not-a-number message
      Returns:
      the parsed value
      Throws:
      InvalidItemException - if the text is not a whole number, is negative, or is larger than max
